description: Daily port activity and shipment estimates of the ports of the Middle East and Central Asia (IMF PortWatch), one data set per country is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by PortWatch. Daily count of port calls, estimates of incoming shipment volumes and outgoing shipment volumes (in metric tons) for ports in United Arab Emirates. Coverage: United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and others. The portal lists 16 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher PortWatch. Its tags are ports, trade. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
